source_window.dataset_title: Practice guide 40: supplement 4 — boundary agreements and determined boundaries

field_evidence.general_boundary_rule: Unless determined under section 60 of the Land Registration Act 2002, the boundary of a registered estate shown for the register is a general boundary.
field_evidence.determined_boundary_semantics: A determined boundary shows the exact line of the boundary of a registered estate.
field_evidence.target_specific_evidence_requirement: The registrar must be satisfied that the plan, or plan and verbal description, identifies the exact line claimed and that the applicant has an arguable case for that exact line.
field_evidence.plan_requirement: The supporting plan must clearly show the extent, start/end/turning points, sufficient surrounding detail and a stated scale.
field_evidence.canonical_extent_limitation: Without a target-specific determined-boundary register entry and supporting plan, this source cannot establish an exact canonical parcel geometry/bbox.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official PG40 supplement 4 confirms that ordinary registered-estate boundaries are general boundaries unless determined under section 60 of the Land Registration Act 2002, and that a determined boundary records the exact line only after target-specific evidence/plan requirements are satisfied. No target-specific determined-boundary register entry/plan is present in the verified lineage. Local OpenCode must retrieve and spatially bind the target-specific determined-boundary/title context before any canonical parcel bbox is asserted; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official HM Land Registry PG40 supplement 4 is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from generic title-plan semantics to the specific determined-boundary procedure. It states that the boundary shown for a registered estate is a general boundary unless determined under section 60, and that a determined boundary shows the exact line only when the exact line has already been identified and supported by the required evidence/plan. The verified lineage contains no target-specific determined-boundary register entry or supporting plan, so no canonical parcel geometry/bbox is asserted. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
